items.q: How much does an app cost?
items.a: It depends on what it needs to do. After a free 30-minute call you get a clear, fixed quote, so there are no surprises later.
You'll have a timeline before any work starts. Along the way you see every screen and try every build, so you always know where things are.
Yes. Once the project is paid, the code, the designs and the accounts are all yours.
We can stay on for updates, fixes and new features, or hand everything over cleanly. Whichever suits you.
We work remotely with founders and teams worldwide, across every time zone. Calls are booked at a time that suits you.
Founders with a first idea, and businesses that need an app for their customers or their team.

process.title: How we work
process.metaDescription: How Studio Innové designs and builds web and mobile apps: a call, clickable designs, weekly builds you can try, then launch and support.
process.headline: From first call to *launch* day.
process.intro: Four simple steps. You see and try everything along the way.

steps.title: Call
steps.line: Thirty minutes on your idea, who it's for and what success looks like. You leave with a clear next step and a fixed quote.

steps.title: Design
steps.line: Every screen is sketched, then turned into a clickable design you can try on your own phone. Nothing is built until you love it.

steps.title: Build
steps.line: We build in small steps and send you a working version every week, so you can try it and steer as it takes shape.

steps.title: Launch
steps.line: We ship it to the web, the App Store and Google Play, then stay on for updates and support if you want us to.

process.statement: Four steps, no surprises. You see and *try* everything, all the way to *launch.*

privacyPage.title: Privacy
body: This site is run by Studio Innové. We keep what we collect to a minimum.

Waitlist. If you join a Studio Originals waitlist we store your email address with our form provider, Formspree, and use it only to email you about that app. Reply to any email or write to us to be removed, and we delete it.
Calls. Booking a call happens on Cal.com, which handles the details you enter there under its own privacy policy.
Analytics. We use Vercel Analytics to count visits. It uses no cookies and does not identify you.
Contact. Questions about your data: contact.studioinnove@gmail.com.
